0022600020.text: The Indiana Pacers (2-3, 10th in the East) visit the Miami Heat (1-4, 13th in the East) in the Pacers' sixth game of the season, with Indiana 2-3 overall, 2-1 on the road, 0-2 at home, and on a two-game losing streak, while Miami is 0-3 at home and has won its most recent game. Out for Indiana are Ben Sheppard (knee), Ivica Zubac (ankle sprain), Johnny Furphy (knee surgery), T.J. McConnell (hamstring strain), and Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring strain), and Aaron Nesmith (hamstring), Andrew Nembhard (neck soreness), and Obi Toppin (back) are day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Miami's Simone Fontecchio is day-to-day with an illness and also a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Pacers won the 2025-26 series 2-1, including a 135-118 win in Indianapolis on March 29, 2026.
